title: Migrating a production AI agent to GPT-5.6: 2.2x faster, 27% cheaper
summary: A case study from Ploy.ai documenting their migration of a production AI agent to GPT-5.6, achieving 2.2x performance improvement and 27% cost reduction through model optimization and infrastructure changes.
problem_solved: Optimizes production AI agent performance and reduces operational costs through strategic model migration.
why_valuable: Provides concrete metrics and practical insights for teams considering AI model upgrades, with real production results showing significant speed and cost improvements.
